normative_extracts.quote: A TypedArray presents an array-like view of an underlying binary data buffer (ArrayBuffer) with a fixed numeric element type.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: ArrayBuffer allocates a raw contiguous byte block while TypedArray views index it directly without JS object boxing, enabling O(1) transfer between workers.

production_failures.symptom: TypeError: Cannot perform TypedArray.prototype.set on a detached ArrayBuffer
production_failures.root_cause: Sending an ArrayBuffer in postMessage transfer list detaches its byte length to 0 in the sending thread; subsequent reads throw.
production_failures.mitigation: Treat transferred buffers as moved ownership and allocate or return a fresh buffer from the worker.

production_failures.symptom: Corrupted 32-bit integers when parsing network packets across architectures
production_failures.root_cause: TypedArray views use host CPU endianness (usually little-endian), whereas network protocols use big-endian byte order.
production_failures.mitigation: Use DataView.getUint32(offset, false) when decoding explicit big-endian binary formats.
